title: Coinfuty
description: Free crypto futures data: open interest, funding, long/short, liquidations, volume. No API key.
summary: Free crypto futures data: open interest, funding, long/short, liquidations, volume. No API key.
offersHint: Free crypto futures data: open interest, funding, long/short, liquidations, volume. No API key. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.coinfuty.com/api/mcp

toolsPreview.name: get_market_overview
toolsPreview.description: Aggregated crypto futures market snapshot: total open interest (USD, with 1h/24h % change), total liquidations (24h), Fear & Greed index, average RSI across coins, plus a 30-day daily series of open interest and liquidations. Data aggregated across major exchanges.

toolsPreview.name: get_coins_markets
toolsPreview.description: List coins with live futures market data: price, 1h/24h/7d price change, open interest (with 24h change), current funding rate (OI-weighted, % per interval), 24h volume, 24h liquidations, 24h long/short ratio, and market cap. Sortable; filter to specific symbols with `symbols`.

toolsPreview.name: get_coin_summary
toolsPreview.description: Full derivatives snapshot for one coin: price and market cap, open interest with 1h/4h/12h/24h change, volume, liquidations (total/long/short), long/short ratio per exchange, and current funding rate per exchange (OI-weighted aggregate included). The single best tool for “what's happening with X futures”.

toolsPreview.name: get_price_history
toolsPreview.description: Historical time series for one coin. metric=price returns OHLC candles with volume; oi returns open-interest candles (USD); funding returns OI-weighted funding-rate candles (% per interval); long_short returns ratio + taker buy/sell volume; liquidation returns long/short liquidation USD; volume returns taker buy/sell volume USD. Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601, newest N points.

toolsPreview.name: get_funding_rates
toolsPreview.description: Current and accumulated funding rates for one coin on every exchange that lists it: current rate (% per settlement interval, stablecoin- and token-margined), accumulated 1d/7d/30d/1y, settlement interval hours, and next funding time. Includes the OI-weighted aggregate rate.

toolsPreview.name: get_exchange_breakdown
toolsPreview.description: How one coin's futures activity splits across exchanges. metric=oi returns each exchange's open interest USD with 1h/4h/12h/24h % change (window ignored); long_short returns ratio + taker buy/sell volume per exchange; liquidation returns long/short liquidation USD; volume returns traded volume USD with % changes. `total` is the coin-level aggregate.

toolsPreview.name: list_exchanges
toolsPreview.description: Top cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges tracked by Coinfuty, with open interest, 24h volume, 24h liquidations, futures maker/taker fees, number of markets, and CMC rank.
